eligibility_reason: PARTIAL CANONICAL COVERAGE: 42 genuine documentary/scalar findings do not encode the complete empirical numerical panel. Sixteen composite output families remain mandatory outside the scalar findings list: two monkey-specific full connectivity/top-ten edgewise-SD outputs; two full 999-original/1000-shuffled correlation distributions and their source comparison; four final-bin condition-level suppression amplitude/comparison families; and eight context-by-axis correct/error magnitude/comparison families. Each family keeps its original support and source units. No invented reduction, categorical replacement or complete-coverage claim is permitted. The full lambda/projection/fit ensembles and every companion control below also remain required. Computational reproduction is independently meaningful for the original two-monkey empirical mechanism and all companion controls, without requiring superiority. Source parity, full numerical outputs, conflicting error statistics and justified reproduction criteria remain unresolved, so neither documentary agreement nor cached named reconstruction is admitted as AI reproduction.

source_paper.title: Latent circuit inference from heterogeneous neural responses during cognitive tasks

evidence.locator: Results: Representations of irrelevant stimuli in the PFC; Figure 6 and Extended Data Figures 7-9
evidence.supports: Original two-monkey empirical task reports projected test R-squared 0.88/0.76 and captured total variance 11%/7%; fit-quality and connectivity summaries use different fit aggregations.

evidence.locator: Methods: Analysis of PFC data, equations 28-32; Statistics and reproducibility
evidence.supports: Original half-trial design, preprocessing, eligibility, three-term empirical objective and 200 initializations per monkey. Methods and Results report different unit counts; printed loss does not by itself resolve reported R-squared implementation.

evidence.locator: latent_net.py lines 79-104, loss and normalized-error helpers
evidence.supports: Released class uses mse_z + l_y*nmse_y; projected diagnostic normalization uses centered full-dimensional data variance. It does not establish the paper's empirical fitted-intercept/three-term objective or sampling adapter.
Inspected release demonstrates a trained-RNN tutorial; a complete original empirical-PFC entry point was not established.

evidence.locator: Mante et al. 2013 data page: PFC data.zip and tdr.zip
evidence.supports: Original neural-data and targeted-dimensionality-reduction archive routes exist. Archive payload, trial membership and eligibility were not read or authenticated in this audit.

evidence.locator: Results, Representations of irrelevant stimuli in the PFC (Sec7)
evidence.supports: Two-monkey projected fit, total variance, four suppression U/p reports, no-recurrence variance and error-trial claims. Some error statistics conflict with Extended Data 7d/8d and remain unresolved.

Projected context/choice/motion/color trajectories; context-to-irrelevant-sensory inhibitory and sensory-to-choice checkerboard connectivity; edgewise SD across top ten fits; zero-recurrence companion.

Lambda tradeoff and 0.4/0.5/0.6 sensitivity; 200-fit means with 1000-resample 95% bootstrap bands; choice-sorted projections; 1000 original and 1000 permutation fits; irrelevant and relevant correct/error contrasts.
Same complete companion panel as monkey A; error-trial numerical context assignments conflict with Results; lambda trend wording repeats r_Q with opposing trends.
Full recurrent projections/connectivity and top-ten edgewise SD; zero-recurrence motion suppression is reduced while color suppression remains, unlike a universal no-suppression claim.
Absolute projection at last stimulus bin, labelled 800 ms, across all 36 correct-trial conditions per context; four one-sided suppression comparisons and boxplot summaries.

evidence.locator: Methods, Testing the dependence of latent connectivity on neural responses (Sec12)
evidence.supports: For each monkey use 1000 original fits, best-versus-other-999 correlations, and 1000 condition permutations preserving task input-output; comparison uses one-sided Mann-Whitney U. This companion is not replaced by the core 200 fits.

target.description: Infer a compact recurrent circuit accounting for the original two-monkey PFC condition-averaged responses and native context-dependent task output, retaining all 72 stimulus/context conditions.

dataset.description: Original Mante et al. 2013 PFC dataset used by the paper, with public PFC data.zip and tdr.zip routes; exact archive identity and empirical adapter remain admission blockers.

cohort.description: Both monkeys A and F are required. Results lists 727/574 PFC units; Methods lists 762/640 available and 483/323 meeting at least four correct trials in every condition. These denominators require source/data reconciliation; none may be chosen for convenience.

split.description: Preserve the original condition-wise disjoint equal half-trial train/validation protocol and full original eligible population. Use historical memberships if available, or documented stochastic draws from that same protocol with seed/membership provenance, predeclared calibration tolerance and paired candidate-author evaluation. A new held-animal, nested or condition-blocked protocol remains an extension.

inputs.description: Original unit-level correct-trial neural responses, 2 x 6 x 6 context/motion/color condition identities, and native continuous task-output targets. Non-simultaneous units cannot be treated as synchronized population trials.

preprocessing.description: Published processing includes 50-ms bins, 40-ms Gaussian smoothing, split-specific z-scoring, condition-independent mean subtraction and PCA retaining 50% variance. The 15 neural samples versus 150 model steps of 10 ms and empirical intercept/loss adapter are unbound.

metric.description: Paper reports projected test R-squared, but equations 31-32 print normalized norm-based error terms and the released diagnostic helper uses a different variance normalization. Recover exact centering, squaring and conversion to reported R-squared; a standard formula cannot be assumed.

aggregation.description: Keep A and F separate. Extended Data 7a/8a describes means over 200 fits with bootstrap intervals; top-ten fits in Figure 6b/Extended Data 9b summarize connectivity weights. The exact relationship of rounded 0.88/0.76 to score-producing fit aggregates remains unbound.

full_panel.description: PARTIAL CANONICAL COVERAGE: 42 genuine documentary/scalar findings do not encode the complete empirical numerical panel. Sixteen composite output families remain mandatory outside the scalar findings list: two monkey-specific full connectivity/top-ten edgewise-SD outputs; two full 999-original/1000-shuffled correlation distributions and their source comparison; four final-bin condition-level suppression amplitude/comparison families; and eight context-by-axis correct/error magnitude/comparison families. Each family keeps its original support and source units. No invented reduction, categorical replacement or complete-coverage claim is permitted. The full lambda/projection/fit ensembles and every companion control below also remain required. The selected original empirical PFC finding comprises both monkeys, all eligible units and 72 conditions; projected fit, captured total variance and native continuous output; complete 200-fit core and lambda tradeoff/sensitivity; choice-sorted projections; full connectivity and top-ten edgewise SD; zero-recurrence controls with the F-color exception; ED10 suppression distributions and tests; original-1000 versus shuffled-1000 connectivity controls; and all incongruent correct/error irrelevant and relevant-axis comparisons. Exact numerical matrices/curves, original lambda grid, error-statistic conflicts and several source reductions remain unresolved. Synthetic-RNN and perturbation experiments are separate source-paper results outside this registered two-monkey task.

permitted_observations.description: Both AI conditions receive the same source paper and authorized original PFC observations, identities, half-trial protocol and feedback; only the author-code condition adds the pinned official release. Source correct-trial fitting, within-split normalization and separately required error-trial analysis must be preserved with declared exposure. Neither old private targets, published aggregates, prior fit outputs nor source-code tutorial outputs establish an AI computation. Authentic paired delivery, final-feedback limits and cumulative budgets remain unbound.

blocking_issues: PARTIAL CANONICAL COVERAGE: 42 genuine documentary/scalar findings do not encode the complete empirical numerical panel. Sixteen composite output families remain mandatory outside the scalar findings list: two monkey-specific full connectivity/top-ten edgewise-SD outputs; two full 999-original/1000-shuffled correlation distributions and their source comparison; four final-bin condition-level suppression amplitude/comparison families; and eight context-by-axis correct/error magnitude/comparison families. Each family keeps its original support and source units. No invented reduction, categorical replacement or complete-coverage claim is permitted. The full lambda/projection/fit ensembles and every companion control below also remain required.

No source-faithful runnable submitted-analysis interface, independent empirical verifier or immutable full cohort/split/panel/observation/metric/aggregation manifests are bound. Existing fixed-neuron nested-split evaluator is an extension; cached named model alternatives do not authenticate the original endpoint.

Complete cached preparation exists (1402 source records, 483/323 selected coordinates), but Results 727/574 versus Methods 762/640 and biological/session identity remain unresolved. Matching counts does not prove source-equivalent membership.

Recover original preprocessing operands or justify a source-conformant stochastic protocol. Cached PCA47/36 differs from source40/31, source-derived box centers125-825ms differ from the first-center prose100ms, and the 150 model steps/15 neural samples/intercept/loss conversion remain unbound. Do not force ranks or choose an alternative to match anchors.

Bind reported projected R-squared, captured-variance and continuous task-fit definitions, exact lambda grid and fit-selection/reduction. Complete core200, connectivity top10, and permutation1000-original/1000-shuffled ensembles have different roles; none replaces another.

Reconcile source error statistics: A irrelevant-motion p is0.0086 in Results versus0.0064 in ED7d; F Results/caption context-specific p and n mappings conflict. ED7a/8a also repeat r_Q with opposing trend statements. Preserve literal discrepancies until resolved.

Full numerical projection, connectivity, edgewise-dispersion, lambda-curve, permutation-correlation and correct/error reference targets are unbound. Unresolved composite numerical findings require source-defined per-coordinate/per-comparison expansion before eligibility; categorical matches alone cannot close them.

No finding-specific numerical tolerance or inferential reproduction rule is justified. Printed precision, p-values, bootstrap-over-model intervals, optimizer start counts and two animals do not supply an automatic new acceptance band or biological sample minimum.

Bind source-compatible common inputs, author-code-only information addition, independent AI/program execution and granular output verification, provenance/exposure isolation and cumulative resource/access budgets. Historical R validation fit_scope requires the existing exact correction and is not training-only protected prediction.
